rule.partner: Partner-made (carr_is_partner_made): created by joe or dell, or through a shared local door (joe-local, dell-local) into a partner queue (owner joe, dell, a door, joint, or none). A door row owned by an agent seat such as claude is automation; so is anything a system, merge-queue or intake actor creates.
rule.confirmed: Partner-made rows, any later edit attributed to joe or dell (carr_is_partner_actor), a joe/dell history event, or a keep stamp confirmed_by and confirmed_at once. Edits through the shared doors do not confirm. A confirmed row never goes stale.
rule.eligible: Open next actions, open loops (open_loop, team_loop, action_required) and pool candidates made by automation and never confirmed. Renewal-radar candidates are excluded because their sealed daily snapshot owns that membership.
rule.stale: created_at plus days is in the past. Stale only fills the Clear the deck list and hides nothing elsewhere.
rule.expired: Stored status written only by drop or expire_all_matching. Only expired rows leave triage, Home and briefs. Kept for history and reversible with keep.

read.access: Either partner or a partner-sponsored agent sees every deck row, whoever owns it.
read.groups: One group per kind and bucket (stale, expiring_this_week) with total and up to limit rows (default 50, max 200).

apply.authority: Partners are equal operators: either may keep or drop any deck row. Events record the acting partner and each row's prior owner and status.
apply.items: [{kind, id, version, action: keep|drop}], 1-500 rows, one idempotency_key. Any not-found or version refusal changes nothing.
apply.keep: Confirms the row for good, assigns the calling partner as owner (next actions, loops) and restores an expired row.
apply.drop: Stores status expired and does not confirm; loops also record closed_at and an 'expired:' close_outcome.
apply.expire_all_matching: {kind, created_by, created_from, created_before, owner?, text_prefixes?}; timestamps carry an offset; created_by joe or dell refused; door creators allowed and only unconfirmed rows match; owner refused for candidates; at most 10000 matches.
apply.dry_run: true returns would-counts, matched and a 10-row sample with no write and no idempotency key.

consumer_adoption: The app pins this contract before rendering the Home Clear the deck card. Use the row version from the latest read; a version_conflict means re-read.
